Title: Straw Horn
Content: A student is investigating the properties of sound waves and light waves. To learn more about sound, the student constructs a straw horn following the procedure below.

:ibox:`bbtext(Procedure)`

`1`. Collect `text(three)` plastic straws and cut them to `text(three)` different lengths.
`2`. Flatten the top end of `text(each straw)` and cut off the top corners of `text(each straw)`.
`3`. Tape the `text(three)` straws together.
`4`. Blow air downward into `text(each straw)` and listen to the sound.
